name: c3-consumption
compiler: TDM-GCC9.2, O3 march=native C++17; fopenmp only when >1T; no fastmath
native_rng: Actual generated std::mt19937 polar Box-Muller; per-thread generator selected with omp_get_thread_num, seeded per thread. Same seed integer does not mean PCG64 identity.
timing_scope: Independent nonoverlapping 50ms windows inside persistent C++ Network.run, boundary input/stat/log maintenance excluded per window, whole Network.run includes it; no Python startup in window.

pre_generated_noise_policy.layout: Unscaled little-endian float32 C-order [step,runtime_index], each row copied once to same Brian noise_sample array before model scaling .1f
pre_generated_noise_policy.initialization: Whole bounded 2s tape loaded before Network.run; preload included in C++ init, not quantum compute. Resident memory and N-row memcpy included in executable RSS / quantum timing respectively.
pre_generated_noise_policy.qualification: 40 exact nonperiodic 50ms windows. Independent consumption diagnostic/correctness, not a sustained producer pipeline or long-run realtime certification.
